Partnering With

Global Equity Has Hidden Risks

Both the company and the employees are exposed to legal and financial risks. Many factors are in play that make today’s process challenging and complicated.

Ever-changing  Compliance

Each country has specific regulations around equity which constantly change. It exposes you and your employees to financial penalties.

Complicated Tax Codes

Tax codes for equity are extremely complicated. Mistakes are irreversible and it’s easy to miss on large tax breaks.

Costly Manual Work

Setting up and maintaining global equity plans is heavily time-consuming. It requires deep and expensive research.

Before Slice

1

Expensive Setup

It takes me months of work with legal teams to set up equity in new countries.

2

Ongoing Uncertanity

I don’t know if there are new equity regulations I should follow. Especially outside of my home country.

3

Manual Processes

I run board approvals and send out grant letters manually. It’s hard to follow what's happening, takes a lot of time and mistakes happen.

After Slice

1

Easy Setup

Setting up equity plans in new countries is a breeze. It takes just a few minutes to issue equity to new employees.

2

Continuous Compliance Monitoring

I’m informed about the actions I need to take to stay locally compliant in any country and for any employee type.

3

Automated Processes

Equity workflows are done automatically. I’m in control and everything has a full audit trail.

Stay on the Safe Path

Powered by our AI compliance engine, the Slice Global Equity Assurance Platform ensures your exposure risks are virtually zero. Here’s how.

Continuous Global Compliance

Stay compliant worldwide and avoid problems altogether with preemptive alerts that steer you clear of any potential exposure issues.

Global Tax Optimization

Secure Equity Lifecycle Automation

Streamline equity processes  while bolstering protection around mistakes and vulnerabilities.
